name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on a soft exercise mat and step your right foot forward so your right knee is bent at 90 degrees directly above your ankle.
Keep your torso upright with hands on your front thigh or hips.
Gently tuck your pelvis under (posterior pelvic tilt) and squeeze your left glute to engage the front of your left hip.
Shift your weight slightly forward while keeping your chest tall until you feel a deep, gentle stretch in the front of your left hip and thigh.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.
coaching_cues: Avoid hyperextending your lower back; the stretch comes from tucking the pelvis and squeezing the rear glute.
Place an extra towel or pillow under the back knee if you experience joint discomfort.
Breathe deeply and sink comfortably into the stretch.

sources.attribution: Mayo Clinic Lower Extremity Stretching Guide
